If an arc $\xi \subset c_0$ of length at most one joins $x$ to $y$ and initial segments of $D_x,D_y$ meet only at a common endpoint, their union with $\xi $ bounds a disk in $A$.
Proof

↗ lem:no-geodesic-spans-c0-to-c0 \sketch Otherwise the loop is essential; the complementary $c_0$ arc has length at least one, contradicting Lemma 6.
